rounds.title: PBE5AC_COMBINED_PTP_XMIT_1_DAPROT_2_CHAMPION_V6
rounds.hypothesis: Combining /proc/sys/dev/uph_wifi0/ptp_xmit=1 (+6.27% goodput in S72B-R2) with daprot=2 + ff_mcast_airtime_limit=5 (written last per FMX-DISC-11, -16.84% p95 / -65.10% p99 RTT in S72B-R1) on top of pure Stage 68A Champion v5 simultaneously improves goodput and tail latency.

followup_scholar_queries: IEEE 802.11v Directed Multicast Service DMS multicast to unicast PtMP video
IGMPv3 fast leave wireless bridge multicast snooping airtime protection

synthesized_next_mechanisms.scientific_basis: Stage 34A S34A-R1 (+7.244% goodput with ff_mcast_airtime_limit=5) + Stage 35A S35A-R1 Champion v9 (+1.705% goodput, -15.121% p95 RTT) + Stage 39A ubnt_poll_host.ko shared sysctl_table->data buffer clobber guard (write ff_mcast_airtime_limit=5 LAST without voip_bias clobbering it)

rounds.title: PBE5AC_CHAMPION_V6_WITH_NOACK_MODE_0_VERIFICATION
rounds.hypothesis: Applying ff_mcast_airtime_limit=5 followed by scalar writes ptp_xmit=1, daprot=2, and explicit noack_mode=0 (preserving hardware BlockAck vs noack_mode=1 default) on top of Stage 68A Champion v5 prevents shared sysctl_table->data scalar reset and reduces TCP retransmission jitter.
